docs.consent_letter_en:
Subject: Request for Written Consent to Sublet ([LEASED PREMISES ADDRESS])

Dear Landlord/Property Manager,

I, Alex Kim, request your written consent to sublet the leased premises to Jordan Rivera from June 1, 2027 through July 28, 2027. The lease requires express written consent for a sublet and provides for a $150 administrative fee, with no reletting charge if consent is granted (Lease, p. 3).

Please confirm in writing whether you approve this sublet and identify any required forms or steps. I understand that approval does not release me or any other lease resident from lease obligations through the original term, including responsibility for a subtenant's damage (Lease, p. 3). The lease term ends July 31, 2027, and automatically renews month-to-month unless proper written notice is given (Lease, p. 1); this request is not a move-out notice.

The proposed subtenant will comply with the applicable lease terms, including the insurance, utility, repair-request, and move-out requirements. Please confirm the $150 fee and where it should be paid.

Sincerely,
Alex Kim
[Date]
docs.agreement_md_en:
# Sublease Agreement — Draft for Completion and Landlord Approval

**Do not take occupancy until the landlord's written consent is received.** The master lease requires express written consent for a sublet (Lease, p. 3).

## 1. Parties and premises
- **Sublessor:** Alex Kim (the original tenant)
- **Subtenant:** Jordan Rivera
- **Premises:** [LEASED PREMISES ADDRESS]
- **Landlord:** [LANDLORD/PROPERTY MANAGER]
- **Landlord's written consent dated:** [DATE / ATTACH COPY]

## 2. Term
The sublease runs from **June 1, 2027 through July 28, 2027**. It does not extend the master lease. The master lease runs through July 31, 2027 and automatically renews month-to-month unless proper written notice is given (Lease, p. 1). The sublessor remains responsible for handling any required notice to the landlord; this sublease is not that notice.

## 3. Rent
Rent is **$2,150 per month**. The June payment is due June 1, 2027. The amount due for July 1–28 must be agreed and written here before signing: **$[AGREED JULY AMOUNT]**, due July 1, 2027. The parties must state the agreed proration method or confirm that no proration applies. Do not leave this amount unresolved. The master lease requires rent in advance by the 1st through the online resident portal (Lease, p. 1); the parties must confirm in writing how the subtenant will pay the sublessor. Any late charge may be imposed only as allowed by the master lease and applicable law; the lease states an initial $50 charge if rent remains unpaid after the 10th (Lease, p. 1).

## 4. Security deposit and escrow
The subtenant pays a **$1,500 security deposit** to **Rentrail escrow**, to be held until the return inspection. Before payment, the parties must confirm in writing the escrow account's financial institution and that the account arrangement complies with Connecticut's deposit escrow requirements. The sublessor, as a tenant who sublets, is treated as a landlord for deposit purposes. [CT-47a-21-a7] Deposits must be placed in an escrow account at a financial institution, and written escrow information must be provided within 30 days after receipt. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]

The sublessor will provide the subtenant the required written notice stating the deposit amount and the name and address of the financial institution holding it. Any deposit deduction must be for an actual, supportable claim, with a written itemized statement of the nature and amount; the undisputed balance and accrued interest must be returned. [CT-47a-21-d2] The target return date is **August 18, 2027**, subject to any later deadline required by the statutory forwarding-address rule. The subtenant must give the sublessor a forwarding address in writing promptly after move-out. Interest will be handled as required by Connecticut law; the applicable 2027 rate should be checked rather than assumed. [CT-47a-21-i]

## 5. Utilities and services
- **Electricity:** The subtenant is responsible for electricity and must arrange the account before move-in, consistent with the master lease (Lease, p. 2). Confirm with the utility that the account can be opened for this sublet period.
- **Water, sewer, and trash:** The sublessor will pay these charges, as agreed by the parties. The master lease bills these services monthly through Conservice, using an occupant-and-square-footage allocation and a $3.95 monthly service/administrative fee (Lease, p. 2). The sublessor remains responsible to the landlord/billing company; no pass-through to the subtenant is agreed here.
- **Heat and hot water:** Provided by the landlord under the master lease (Lease, p. 2).
- **Internet and cable:** The master lease assigns these to the tenant (Lease, p. 2). The parties must record who will arrange/pay for them: **[AGREED ARRANGEMENT OR “NOT PROVIDED”]**.

## 6. Master lease and house rules
The master lease controls if this agreement conflicts with it. The subtenant agrees to follow the applicable master lease terms and building rules provided before signing, including:
- Keep the premises clean and safe, use fixtures and appliances reasonably, and do not negligently or willfully damage the premises. [CT-47a-11]
- Maintain personal liability insurance of at least **$100,000 per occurrence** and provide proof before move-in, as required by the master lease (Lease, p. 2). Confirm with the landlord whether the subtenant's policy satisfies its occupant/guest coverage requirement.
- Submit non-emergency repair requests through the online resident portal or in signed writing delivered to the office; emergency maintenance is available 24 hours (Lease, p. 2).
- At move-out, clean the unit, remove personal property, return all keys/access devices, and attend or arrange the return inspection (Lease, p. 3). The master lease lists a $75 rekeying charge for each unreturned key (Lease, p. 1); any claim against this deposit must still be properly supported and itemized.
- The master lease lists potential deductions including unpaid rent/utilities, excess cleaning, carpet cleaning, tenant-caused damage beyond ordinary wear, missing keys, and items left behind (Lease, p. 3). A listed lease charge is not automatically a lawful deposit deduction; deductions must meet applicable law and be itemized.

## 7. Hand-off and return inspections
The parties will jointly inspect and photograph the premises at hand-off on or before June 1, 2027, and at return on July 28, 2027. They will complete and sign an inventory/condition record, note existing defects and safety or pest concerns, and give each other copies. The master lease requires defects, damage, and safety or pest concerns to be recorded within 48 hours after move-in (Lease, p. 2). The parties should send the record to the landlord if required by the landlord.

Record keys and access devices provided: **[LIST]**. Return inspection date/time: **[AGREE IN WRITING]**. The subtenant may attend the return inspection.

## 8. Deposit claims and return
The parties will compare the signed hand-off and return records. No deduction will be made for pre-existing conditions or ordinary wear and tear. Any proposed deduction must identify the condition, explain why it is attributable to the subtenant rather than pre-existing or ordinary wear, and state the actual amount with supporting documentation. The sublessor will give the written itemized statement and return the unclaimed balance plus accrued interest by the applicable statutory deadline. [CT-47a-21-d2] [DOB-itemize]

## 9. Continuing responsibility and signatures
Landlord consent does not release the sublessor or other master-lease residents from their obligations through the original lease term, including liability for a subtenant's damage (Lease, p. 3). The subtenant is responsible under this agreement for their own compliance and for damage they cause, subject to proof and applicable law.

**Sublessor:** Alex Kim  Signature: ____________________  Date: __________

**Subtenant:** Jordan Rivera  Signature: ____________________  Date: __________

**Landlord's written consent attached:** Yes / No (consent is required before occupancy).

sublessor_duties.en: As a tenant who sublets, you are a landlord for security-deposit purposes. [CT-47a-21-a7]

sublessor_duties.en: Place the entire deposit in a qualifying escrow account at a financial institution and provide written account information within 30 days. Confirm Rentrail’s account arrangement meets this requirement. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]
sublessor_duties.ko: 보증금 전액을 요건에 맞는 금융기관 에스크로 계좌에 보관하고, 30일 안에 계좌 정보를 서면으로 알려야 합니다. Rentrail 계좌 구조가 요건을 충족하는지 확인하세요. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]

sublessor_duties.en: Return the deposit balance and accrued interest, or provide a written itemized statement of actual damages, by the statutory deadline. The supplied August 18, 2027 date may be extended if the forwarding-address rule sets a later deadline. [CT-47a-21-d2] [CT-47a-21-i]
sublessor_duties.ko: 법정 기한 안에 보증금 잔액과 이자를 돌려주거나 실제 손해의 항목별 명세서를 서면으로 제공하세요. 반환 주소 통지 시점에 따라 제시된 2027년 8월 18일보다 기한이 늦어질 수 있습니다. [CT-47a-21-d2] [CT-47a-21-i]

sublessor_duties.en: Document the hand-off and return condition; claim only supported damage attributable to the subtenant, not pre-existing conditions or ordinary wear. [CT-47a-21-d2] [DOB-itemize]
sublessor_duties.ko: 입주·퇴거 상태를 기록하고, 기존 상태나 통상적인 마모가 아니라 전대인이 일으킨 것으로 입증되는 손해만 청구하세요. [CT-47a-21-d2] [DOB-itemize]

subtenant_checklist.en: Get a copy of the landlord’s written consent before moving in; confirm the $150 fee has been handled (Lease, p. 3).
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 전에 집주인의 서면 동의 사본을 받고, 계약상 $150 수수료 처리 여부를 확인하세요(계약서 3쪽).

subtenant_checklist.en: Before signing, agree in writing on the exact July 1–28 rent and payment method. The monthly rent is $2,150, but no proration method was provided.
subtenant_checklist.ko: 서명 전에 7월 1~28일 임대료 액수와 지급 방법을 서면으로 정하세요. 월세는 $2,150이지만 일할 계산 방식은 제공되지 않았습니다.

subtenant_checklist.en: Photograph and record the move-in condition and existing defects; complete the master-lease condition form within 48 hours (Lease, p. 2).
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 상태와 기존 하자를 사진·서면으로 남기고, 계약서상 48시간 내 상태 점검표를 제출하세요(계약서 2쪽).

subtenant_checklist.en: Confirm the $1,500 deposit is held in a compliant escrow account and obtain written notice naming the financial institution. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]
subtenant_checklist.ko: $1,500 보증금이 요건에 맞는 에스크로 계좌에 보관되는지 확인하고 금융기관 명칭이 적힌 서면 통지를 받으세요. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]

subtenant_checklist.en: Arrange electricity before move-in; clarify internet/cable arrangements and confirm the sublessor is paying water, sewer, and trash as agreed. The master lease requires proof of at least $100,000-per-occurrence liability insurance (Lease, p. 2).
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 전에 전기 계정을 준비하고 인터넷·케이블 부담자를 정하세요. 수도·하수·쓰레기 비용은 합의대로 전대인이 부담하는지 확인하세요. 임대차계약상 사고당 최소 $100,000 책임보험 증명이 필요합니다(계약서 2쪽).

subtenant_checklist.en: Give a forwarding address in writing at move-out and keep a copy. The statutory return deadline depends partly on when that notice is received. [CT-47a-21-d2]
subtenant_checklist.ko: 퇴거할 때 우편물 수령 주소를 서면으로 알리고 사본을 보관하세요. 법정 보증금 반환 기한은 그 통지의 수령 시점에도 좌우됩니다. [CT-47a-21-d2]

risks.en: The sublet ends July 28, while the master lease ends July 31 and may renew month-to-month. The original tenant remains liable through the original term; confirm the landlord's consent and the plan for July 29–31 and any renewal (Lease, pp. 1, 3).
risks.ko: 전대는 7월 28일 끝나지만 원계약은 7월 31일까지이며 월 단위로 자동 갱신될 수 있습니다. 원세입자는 원계약 기간의 의무를 계속 부담하므로, 집주인 동의와 7월 29~31일 및 갱신 처리 방안을 확인하세요(계약서 1·3쪽).

risks.en: The exact rent due for July 1–28 is not established; do not sign until the amount and proration method are written down.
risks.ko: 7월 1~28일 임대료가 정해져 있지 않습니다. 액수와 일할 계산 방식을 서면으로 확정하기 전에는 서명하지 마세요.

risks.en: The lease assigns water, sewer, and trash billing to the tenant through Conservice, but the sublet facts say the sublessor pays them. Keep the sublessor responsible to the landlord and clarify any bill exposure in writing (Lease, p. 2).
risks.ko: 원계약은 Conservice를 통한 수도·하수·쓰레기 요금을 세입자 부담으로 정하지만, 전대 조건은 전대인 부담입니다. 집주인에 대한 납부 책임은 전대인이 유지하고, 청구서 관련 책임을 서면으로 분명히 하세요(계약서 2쪽).

risks.en: A platform described as “Rentrail escrow” may not by itself establish that the funds are in the Connecticut financial-institution escrow account required by law. Verify the account and notice details before accepting the deposit. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]
risks.ko: ‘Rentrail 에스크로’라는 표현만으로 법에서 요구하는 금융기관 에스크로 계좌인지 확인되는 것은 아닙니다. 보증금을 받기 전에 실제 계좌와 통지 내용을 확인하세요. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]

risks.en: The lease requires 60 days’ written move-out notice and says the tenancy auto-renews without proper notice (Lease, p. 3 and p. 1). The sublease does not substitute for that notice; check whether notice has already been given and whether the original tenant could remain liable after July 31.
risks.ko: 원계약은 60일 전 서면 퇴거 통지를 요구하고 적절한 통지가 없으면 자동 갱신된다고 합니다(계약서 3쪽·1쪽). 전대계약은 그 통지를 대신하지 않으므로 이미 통지했는지, 7월 31일 이후에도 원세입자 책임이 이어지는지 확인하세요.

risks.en: The supplied August 18, 2027 return date assumes the ordinary 21-day calculation from July 28. A later forwarding-address notice can change the statutory deadline; the applicable 2027 interest rate also needs checking. [CT-47a-21-d2] [CT-47a-21-i]
risks.ko: 제시된 2027년 8월 18일은 7월 28일 종료 후 21일 계산을 전제로 합니다. 우편주소 통지가 늦으면 법정 기한이 달라질 수 있고, 2027년 적용 이자율도 확인해야 합니다. [CT-47a-21-d2] [CT-47a-21-i]

docs.summary_ko: 집주인의 서면 동의를 먼저 받고, 승인 시 계약상 $150 수수료를 확인하세요. 7월 1~28일 임대료와 일할 계산 방식, 인터넷·케이블 부담자를 서명 전에 서면으로 확정해야 합니다. 원계약은 7월 31일까지이며 자동 갱신될 수 있고, 원세입자는 원계약 의무에 계속 책임집니다. 보증금은 법에 맞는 금융기관 에스크로에 보관되는지 확인하고, 입·퇴거 상태를 기록하세요. 보증금 반환 목표일은 2027년 8월 18일이지만 우편주소 통지 시점에 따라 법정 기한이 달라질 수 있습니다.

items.reason_en: The star-shaped wall crack is visible in later Evidence #42, while the earlier record lists no defects and the bedroom video frames #31–#35 show no recorded crack; no earlier finding matches this spot.
items.reason_ko: 후기 Evidence #42에서 별 모양의 벽 균열이 보입니다. 이전 기록에는 결함이 없고 침실 영상 프레임 #31–#35에도 이 균열이 기록되어 있지 않아, 같은 위치의 기존 결함으로 볼 근거가 없습니다.

later.location: Left-of-center, around mid-wall height, beside the writing “Cracked!!”
later.description_en: A prominent star-shaped crack is visible on the wall. It is shown in the demo convention as a real crack.
later.description_ko: 벽 중앙 높이의 왼쪽에 별 모양 균열이 뚜렷하게 보입니다. 데모 규칙에 따라 실제 균열로 기록합니다.

comparison.summary_en: The wall crack is classified as new damage because it was not recorded in the clean earlier handoff record.
comparison.summary_ko: 이전 인계 기록이 깨끗하고 해당 균열이 기록되지 않아 새 손상으로 분류했습니다.

items.item: Bedroom wall crack at left-of-center, mid-wall height, beside “Cracked!!”
items.reason_en: Proposed deduction: $225, a provisional modest estimate for patching and repainting one wall section; confirm the actual reasonable cost with a quote or invoice before finalizing. Evidence #42 shows the star-shaped crack at the stated location. The hand-off/return comparison identifies it as new damage. Do not claim ordinary wear or pre-existing damage. Provide written itemization and return the unclaimed deposit balance plus accrued interest within the applicable statutory deadline.
items.reason_ko: 공제 제안액은 $225입니다. 벽 한 구역을 메우고 다시 칠하는 데 드는 소액의 잠정 추정치이므로, 최종 공제 전 견적서나 영수증으로 실제 합리적 수리비를 확인하세요. 증거 #42에는 지정된 위치의 별 모양 균열이 보이며, 인수·반환 비교 자료는 이를 신규 손상으로 분류합니다. 통상적인 마모나 기존 손상은 청구하지 마세요. 공제 내역을 서면으로 항목별 통지하고, 미청구 보증금 잔액과 발생 이자를 해당 법정 기한 내에 반환하세요.

claim.summary_en: Propose only the $225 provisional repair deduction for the new bedroom wall crack shown in Evidence #42. Confirm the actual reasonable cost with a quote or invoice, itemize any final claim, and return the remaining escrow deposit plus accrued interest by the applicable deadline. No utility deduction is included.
claim.summary_ko: 증거 #42에 보이는 신규 침실 벽 균열에 대해서만 잠정 수리비 $225를 공제안으로 제시합니다. 견적서나 영수증으로 실제 합리적 수리비를 확인하고, 최종 청구액을 항목별로 통지한 뒤 미청구 보증금과 발생 이자를 해당 기한 내 반환하세요. 공과금은 공제하지 않았습니다.

items.item: Bedroom wall crack at left-of-center, mid-wall height, beside “Cracked!!”
items.note_en: Approve up to $225 for the proven new crack, but only to the extent a quote or invoice confirms the actual reasonable repair cost; reduce the deduction if the documented cost is lower. The evidence date needs checking before the notice is sent.
items.note_ko: 신규 균열에 대해 최대 $225까지 인정하되, 견적서나 영수증으로 실제 합리적인 수리비가 확인되는 범위에서만 공제하세요. 증빙된 비용이 더 낮으면 공제액도 낮춰야 합니다. 통지서를 보내기 전에 증거 날짜를 확인해야 합니다.

items.note_en: Approve the computed subtenant share of $88.10 for the full 30-day overlap. Include it as an itemized utility amount.
items.note_ko: 30일 전체 중복 기간에 대한 계산된 전기요금 분담액 $88.10을 인정합니다. 공과금 항목으로 명세하세요.

ruling.ruling_en: The new bedroom-wall crack is identified as damage arising during the sublet, so a deduction is justified, but it may not exceed the documented actual reasonable repair cost or the $225 claimed. The computed June electricity share of $88.10 is also approved. From the $1,500 escrow, the remaining principal is $1,186.90, plus accrued interest, assuming the full $225 repair amount is documented; if the documented repair cost is lower, the balance must increase accordingly. The sublessor must provide a written itemization and return the unclaimed balance plus interest within the statutory time. Confirm the date of Exhibit E42 and retain the repair quote or invoice.
ruling.ruling_ko: 전대 기간 중 발생한 것으로 확인된 침실 벽 균열은 공제 대상이 될 수 있지만, 실제 합리적 수리비 증빙액과 청구액 $225 중 더 낮은 금액까지만 공제할 수 있습니다. 계산된 6월 전기요금 분담액 $88.10도 인정합니다. 수리비 $225 전액이 증빙된다는 전제에서 $1,500 보증금 중 원금 잔액은 발생 이자 별도로 $1,186.90입니다. 수리비 증빙액이 더 낮으면 반환 잔액은 그만큼 늘어납니다. 전대인은 법정 기한 내 항목별 서면 명세와 미청구 잔액 및 이자를 반환해야 합니다. Exhibit E42의 날짜를 확인하고 수리 견적서나 영수증을 보관하세요.
ruling.letter_en:
Subject: Settlement notice — sublet escrow deposit

To [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2]:

This notice records the proposed settlement of the $1,500 escrow deposit for the sublet from June 1 through July 28, 2027.

Please provide both parties with a written itemization of the damage and utility amounts and deliver the undisputed balance plus accrued interest to [PERSON_2] at the forwarding address on file. If the repair cost is not fully documented, return the corresponding additional amount. Connecticut General Statutes §47a-21(a)(7) treats a tenant who sublets as a landlord; §47a-21(a)(14) addresses eligible utility obligations; and §47a-21(d)(2) and §47a-21(j)(2), together with the Department of Banking’s Rental Security Deposits guidance (DOB-itemize), require timely return, itemization, and written notice of a good-faith damages claim. The statutory deadline is no later than 21 days after the tenancy ends or 15 days after receipt of the forwarding address, whichever is later.

Please confirm the agreed accounting and send the itemization, supporting repair documentation, and applicable refund within 10 days of receiving this notice. The date of Exhibit E42 should be verified before finalizing the notice.

[PERSON_2]
